description: Client horizon (4yr) below ETF minimum (5yr) — R3 soft fail (−15), score 85 SUITABLE
client_narrative: Sara Lindqvist is 40 years old and works as a school teacher. She earns about 40,000 euros a year and holds 25,000 euros in liquid savings. She wants to invest 15,000 euros for roughly four years — she plans to use the money for a home renovation project after that period. Sara has basic investment knowledge; she has previously bought mutual funds through her bank but has no experience with individual stocks or derivatives. She describes her risk tolerance as 4 out of 10 — willing to accept some market fluctuations but not comfortable with major losses. She has confirmed she cannot afford to lose her investment. Her goal is moderate portfolio growth.
product_narrative: The product is a passively managed exchange-traded fund that tracks the MSCI World Index, providing diversified exposure to approximately 1,500 large and mid-cap equities across 23 developed markets. The fund is listed on major European exchanges, trades intraday with high liquidity, publishes a KID, contains no embedded derivatives, and uses no leverage. The recommended minimum investment horizon is five years.
